## 2025-05-22 - CSS Injection in dynamic ChartStyle `<style>` blocks
**Vulnerability:** User-controlled config keys, ID values, or color values passed directly into dangerouslySetInnerHTML of `<style>` tags can break out of selectors and properties to inject arbitrary CSS rules (e.g. keyloggers or clickjacking overlay rules).
**Learning:** Even internal-looking IDs (like those generated by `useId`) can be overridden via props. If attributes like `[data-chart=${id}]` are not quoted, space-separated or quote-breakout characters can escape the attribute selector block.
**Prevention:** Always quote the selector attribute (e.g., `[data-chart="${safeId}"]`) and strictly sanitize ID, property keys, and color values before injecting them into stylesheet templates.
